title: JANUS POSS-I Plate-Day Exposure — Phase-0 Acquisition, Provenance and H0/H1 Admission Gate
purpose: Turn the POSS-I nuclear/UAP correlation question into a byte-frozen, plate-day exposure-normalized test of H0 schedule/artifact versus H1 non-zero baseline plus nuclear trigger/modulator, without silently substituting public but non-equivalent catalogs.

substitution_forbidden: the public SVO 5,399-candidate final unidentified catalog
an independently regenerated catalog such as the Hayes 2.85M-feature catalog
aggregate daily counts without the 107,875 source-to-plate binding
source_level_catalog.reason: Those are scientifically useful controls but are not byte-equivalent to the catalog used for the target association.

validated_catalog.role: candidate-quality/ML sensitivity only; thresholds must be frozen before inspection of nuclear effect

count_reconciliation_gate.rule: Do not delete, add, normalize or silently date-filter the 13-record difference. Identify exact row membership and transformation responsible before admission.

STScI_MAST_DSS_plate_list.known_current_context: MAST describes POSS-I E / XE as a 936-plate survey and notes that plate metadata files are updated when errors are corrected.
STScI_MAST_DSS_plate_list.freeze_rule: Download once for an analysis release, record retrieval timestamp, raw SHA-256 and source URL, and never let a later mutable download silently replace the frozen bytes.
STScI_MAST_DSS_plate_list.primary_denominator_rule: Do not treat all 936 POSS-I E plates as target exposure unless source-level provenance shows they were actually eligible for the 107,875-candidate pipeline. The primary matrix is bound to the 635 target plate IDs; the full STScI schedule is a separate sensitivity/control layer.

digitization_provenance.known_context: STScI/CASB documentation identifies First Generation POSS-I E DSS material as glass-copy material; original plate, copy generation, scanner and processing lineage must therefore be stored separately rather than collapsed into a generic 'plate' field.

exposure_time.source: DSS FITS header EXPOSURE keyword / plate metadata
exposure_time.rule: Use exact per-plate values where available; do not hard-code one nominal exposure for all plates in the admitted matrix.

reported_source_family: DOE/NV-209 Rev.16 for United States tests
the source used by the 2025 paper for Soviet tests
the source used by the 2025 paper for British tests
original_study_reproduction.rule: First reproduce the exact source definitions used by the target paper, even where a later or more authoritative source is preferred for sensitivity analysis.

independent_control_calendar.importance: 124 versus 126 is not a rounding difference; both calendars must be frozen before looking at beta_nuclear and run as preregistered sensitivity definitions.

authoritative_anchors.UK: UK Parliament/Hansard table of overseas atmospheric nuclear weapons tests provides dated/type/height records
authoritative_anchors.USSR: An authoritative row-complete source must be frozen before the authoritative-calendar branch is admitted; do not infer missing Soviet rows from memory.

plate_day_matrix_contract.grain: one row per target plate_id x UTC observation date/exposure opportunity
plate_day_matrix_contract.exposure_definition_primary: observed/processed sky area multiplied by exposure time, preferably exact algorithmically eligible footprint rather than nominal plate area
plate_day_matrix_contract.fallback: plate-day counts without area-time exposure are descriptive schedule diagnostics only and cannot admit primary beta_nuclear

hypotheses.H0_schedule_artifact: Given actual observation opportunity and plate/copy/scanner/environmental covariates, candidate counts require no nuclear term; beta_nuclear = 0 within uncertainty.
hypotheses.H1_baseline_plus_trigger: A non-zero baseline exists outside nuclear windows, but a nuclear-window term remains after frozen exposure and artifact/environmental controls; beta_nuclear != 0.
hypotheses.causal_boundary: H1 support would establish residual association only. It would not identify the transient features as physical sky events, UAP, non-human objects, or a nuclear causal mechanism.

analysis_preregistration.primary_model: Negative Binomial NB2 count model with estimated dispersion and log(exposure_deg2_min) exposure term
mandatory_sensitivity: alternate frozen nuclear calendars without post-hoc choice
block/cluster permutation preserving observation schedule and seasonality
geomagnetic and weather covariates where source-complete
candidate-quality/ML thresholds only when threshold is preregistered
analysis_preregistration.multiple_testing_rule: The +/-1 day full-catalog test is primary. Alternate windows, quality thresholds and geometry strata are sensitivity analyses and may not replace the primary result post hoc.

column_mapping_contract.rule: Column names are mapped explicitly after receipt; the runner must not guess schema aliases from scientific meaning.

Hayes_2026_full_footprint.interpretation: An explicit observation-footprint/exposure analysis on an independently generated POSS-I feature catalog reports no nuclear enhancement. This raises the prior probability that schedule/exposure can explain the original calendar-day association, but it does not compute beta_nuclear for the closed 107,875 VASCO catalog.

admission_gates.pass: 107,875-row/635-plate catalog plus 2,718-row daily master received and byte-hashed
13-record 107875-vs-107862 difference explained by explicit row transformation
635 plate IDs joined to frozen schedule, exposure and original/copy/scanner provenance with no ambiguous joins
124-study reproduction calendar and 126-control definition both frozen before effect inspection
candidate sum and plate identities reconcile and every primary row has positive exposure denominator
primary and mandatory sensitivity outputs emitted from frozen inputs
only an explicitly admitted result may create/switch a current-authority pointer

next_external_action.required: Obtain the exact three VASCO input files from the original authors/replication data custodians under the paper's reasonable-request condition.
next_external_action.after_receipt: Run phase0 validate immediately before inspecting nuclear effect size; freeze raw hashes and column mapping; then join plate provenance and execute the preregistered matrix/model path.
